formats.name: Short Vertical Video (9:16)
formats.purpose: High-velocity narrative capture and authority proof in under 90 seconds.
formats.hook_logic: Must deliver first hook trigger within 0-3 seconds; pain point open loop by 5 seconds.
formats.visual_rules: Vertical 9:16 safe zones (avoid UI overlays at top 15% and bottom 25%); kinetic subtitles; dynamic camera punch-ins.

formats.name: Horizontal Episodic / Longform Video (16:9)
formats.purpose: In-depth case autopsies, strategic breakdowns, and master episodic deep-dives.
formats.hook_logic: Intro Lab 3-Act structure: unignorable promise in 0-45s with multi-layer VO and B-roll source replacement.
formats.visual_rules: 16:9 cinematic framing; clean lower thirds; multi-camera switches; document and screen overlays.

formats.name: LinkedIn Document Carousel (PDF Slide Set)
formats.purpose: Visual thinking models, step-by-step protocols, and executive decision maps.
formats.hook_logic: Slide 1 cover hook with high tension title and subtitle; Slide 2 thesis reframe; progressive reveal.
formats.visual_rules: Strict typographic hierarchy; minimum 32pt body text equivalent; color-coded decision paths; no unformatted walls of text.

formats.name: Podcast Master Episode (Multi-Speaker Audio/Video)
formats.purpose: Full-length conversational master recording serving as the unmined mother corpus for clips, shorts, and carousels.
formats.hook_logic: Dynamic cold open excerpting the highest tension moment of the interview in first 20 seconds.
formats.visual_rules: Isolated multi-track audio; dual ISO camera feeds + wide angle master.

formats.name: Standalone Podcast Excerpt Clip (Horizontal or Vertical)
formats.purpose: Self-contained thematic extract from a podcast master that resolves a full narrative arc without requiring parent episode context.
formats.hook_logic: Clear thesis question or debate opening stated within first 5 seconds.
formats.visual_rules: Active speaker tracking; waveform overlay when off-camera; contextual lower thirds.

formats.name: LinkedIn Text / Editorial Post
formats.purpose: Direct written commentary, executive insight, and community discussion catalyst.
formats.hook_logic: High-impact opening sentence (first 140 chars before 'see more' truncation); generous line breaks for readability.
formats.visual_rules: Optional single high-resolution graph, screenshot, or quote card.

formats.name: Hybrid Video-Slide Technical Briefing
formats.purpose: Technical walkthrough synchronizing talking-head video with interactive architecture slides and telemetry.
formats.hook_logic: Demonstrating a live software or lab benchmark problem within the first 10 seconds.
formats.visual_rules: 70/30 split screen (70% slide/screen, 30% circular talking-head presenter).

formats.name: Newsletter Technical Deep-Dive Article
formats.purpose: Comprehensive written analysis sent to subscribers with primary citations and actionable checklists.
formats.hook_logic: Curated editorial executive summary upfront answering 'Why this matters this week'.
formats.visual_rules: Embedded charts, callout blockquotes, code snippets, and structured subheaders.
